title: Seascape
author: Alexander Alekseev aka TDM
noteOnAuthor: NOT by Dave Hoskins (Dave_Hoskins). The 'Ms2SD1' shortcode resolves to TDM's 'Seascape' (2014). Confirmed by two independent sources: the ISF auto-conversion embeds the header comment '// "Seascape" by Alexander Alekseev aka TDM - 2014', and the Godot port repo describes itself as 'The TDM Seascape Shadertoy shader ported to godot: https://www.shadertoy.com/view/Ms2SD1'.
type: fragment shader, single pass (Image tab), raymarched heightfield ocean
obtainedViaDetail: ISF.video (Interactive Shader Format web editor) auto-converts ShaderToy shaders and serves the converted fragment source as JSON: {"title":"st_Ms2SD1.fs","description":"Automatically converted from https://www.shadertoy.com/view/Ms2SD1","rawFragmentSource":"..."}. The ShaderToy page itself was unreachable (Cloudflare 403 for curl, headless Chromium, and headful real Chrome 156).
method: 1) web_search for 'Ms2SD1' surfaced https://editor.isf.video/shaders/6769241c2909a9001a007182 titled 'st_Ms2SD1.fs'. 2) The site is a React SPA, so Playwright was used to load it and capture XHR responses; the public JSON endpoint was identified. 3) Endpoint fetched directly with curl (no auth, no Cloudflare). 4) ShaderToy-specific identifiers were mechanically restored (RENDERSIZE->iResolution, TIME->iTime, ISF INPUT uniforms -> original const declarations, main()->mainImage()).
verification: Cross-checked against bteitler's annotated copy (https://github.com/eshnil2000/SeascapeGPUShader) - identical globals, identical declaration order, identical constants, identical function bodies.
Cross-checked against Godot port https://github.com/creikey/tdm-godot-ocean/blob/HEAD/src/TDMOpenOcean.shader (same structure and values, with art tweaks).
Cross-checked against Cesium port https://github.com/red-fire-code/cesium-water-polygon/blob/main/WaterPolygon.ts (same functions, same loop structure).
Brace/paren balance verified; no leftover ISF tokens outside the provenance comment block.
knownUncertainty: SEA_TIME: the ISF auto-conversion and bteitler's copy both read 'float SEA_TIME = iTime * SEA_SPEED;' (global). Some later re-writes/ports (e.g. DarelCullen/3dshaders presets.js, red-fire-code Cesium port) use '#define SEA_TIME (1.0 + iTime * SEA_SPEED)'. This only shifts the wave phase by one time unit - visually identical. The file here uses the ISF/bteitler form.

files.notes.md: Method, reconstruction deltas, shader structure/techniques, Cesium/Three/Godot/HLSL port references.

files.raw/isf-frag.glsl: Verbatim rawFragmentSource exactly as served (ISF dialect, unmodified).
files.raw/cesium-fabric-material.glsl: ShaderToy->Cesium Fabric material port extracted from WaterPolygon.ts.
files.raw/cesium-water-waterpolygon.ts: Full Cesium port source (Cesium.Material fabric + custom vertex/fragment shaders).
files.raw/eshnil-readme.md: bteitler's annotated Seascape copy (verbatim original + documentation comments).
files.raw/ms2sd1-render.png: Frame rendered from ms2sd1-source.glsl in headless Chromium (WebGL1) - visual proof of fidelity.

validation.webgl2Note: Fails under GLSL ES 3.00: 'global variable initializers must be constant expressions' at the EPSILON_NRM and SEA_TIME globals. Move them into mainImage when porting.
